title: Landfall and Provision
author: Paloma Ishikawa
blurb: Astrid Reyes, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
